manrope.processed: fontTools subset, Latin and Latin Extended-A, punctuation and navigation arrows; WOFF2 variable
manrope.loaded: self-hosted, display optional; one cross-origin anonymous preload in document head
manrope.design_notes: One family for body and display. No runtime third-party font request. Optional display prevents a delayed face swap from causing layout shifts.

display.role: Display voice: titles, chapters, display numerals (founder choice A1, October 18, 2026)
display.reserved_font_name: None declared (copyright line: "Copyright 2020 The Newsreader Project Authors"), so the modified instance keeps the family name
display.processed: fontTools 4.60.1: varLib.instancer opsz=72 wght=400, then subset to WOFF2 with features kern liga calt lnum tnum pnum case, no hinting
display.not_in_font: U+0132-0133, U+0149, U+017F and the arrows U+2190-2193, U+2197 (served by the Manrope "Display Arrows" face)
display.fallback: local('Georgia') with size-adjust 101.5%, ascent-override 72.41%, descent-override 26.11% (advance widths measured on heading text)
display.loaded: self-hosted, display swap, preloaded on every route
